# supermemory | Memory API for the AI era

> Frontier agent memory and context platform

- [Introduction](https://supermemory.ai/docs/index.md): Context infrastructure for AI agents
- [What is Supermemory?](https://supermemory.ai/docs/overview/what-is-supermemory.md): Supermemory is the long term and short term context and memory infrastructure for agents.
- [Comparison - should I use supermemory?](https://supermemory.ai/docs/overview/comparison.md): How Supermemory compares with a DIY vector stack, thin memory layers, pure RAG and building it yourself.
- [Quickstart](https://supermemory.ai/docs/quickstart.md): Ingest a conversation and a document, retrieve them three ways, then wire it into a chat harness.
- [Agents, skills and MCP](https://supermemory.ai/docs/agents-and-mcp.md): Set up coding agents to integrate Supermemory with the CLI, the skill and the docs MCP.
- [How Supermemory works](https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/how-it-works.md): How a file or chat turn becomes something you can search: the ingest pipeline, statuses and outputs.
- [Graph memory](https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/graph-memory.md): How facts connect, update and stay true: relationships, temporal truth and automatic forgetting.
- [Supported content types](https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/content-types.md): All the content formats Supermemory can ingest and process
- [SuperRAG (managed RAG as a service)](https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/super-rag.md): Supermemory provides a managed RAG solution - extraction, indexing, storing, and retrieval.
- [Memory vs RAG: Understanding the difference](https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/memory-vs-rag.md): Learn why agent memory and RAG are fundamentally different, and when to use each approach
- [Multi-tenancy overview](https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/multi-tenancy.md): How Supermemory isolates and organizes memories across users, tenants, and projects
- [Multi-tenancy examples](https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/multi-tenancy-examples.md): Common namespace and metadata patterns for personal agents, company agents, email assistants, and support platforms
- [Namespaces](https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/container-tags.md): Namespaces, formerly container tags, are the isolation boundary that partitions memories by user, project, or any logical scope
- [Organizing & filtering memories](https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/filtering.md): Use namespaces and metadata to organize and retrieve memories
- [User profiles](https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/user-profiles.md): Automatically maintained context about your users
- [Profile buckets](https://supermemory.ai/docs/user-profiles/buckets.md): Custom topical categories for user profiles
- [Using Supermemory](https://supermemory.ai/docs/using-supermemory.md): The full loop: authenticate, put context in, get it back out, keep it correct.
- [API keys & auth](https://supermemory.ai/docs/authentication.md): Org API keys, namespace-scoped keys, and connector branding.
- [Invite team members](https://supermemory.ai/docs/invite-team-members.md): Invite a colleague to your Supermemory organization, choose their access, and share the invitation link.
- [Customizing for your use case](https://supermemory.ai/docs/concepts/customization.md): Configure Supermemory's behavior for your specific application
- [Ingesting context to supermemory](https://supermemory.ai/docs/ingestion/add-memories.md): Add text, files, and URLs to Supermemory
- [Document operations](https://supermemory.ai/docs/ingestion/document-operations.md): List, get, update, and delete your ingested documents
- [Connectors overview](https://supermemory.ai/docs/connectors/overview.md): Integrate Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, GitHub, Granola and Web Crawler to automatically sync documents into your knowledge base
- [Notion connector](https://supermemory.ai/docs/connectors/notion.md): Sync Notion pages, databases, and blocks with real-time webhooks and workspace integration
- [Google Drive connector](https://supermemory.ai/docs/connectors/google-drive.md): Connect Google Drive to sync documents into your Supermemory knowledge base
- [Gmail connector](https://supermemory.ai/docs/connectors/gmail.md): Sync email threads from Gmail with real-time Pub/Sub webhooks and incremental sync
- [OneDrive connector](https://supermemory.ai/docs/connectors/onedrive.md): Sync Microsoft Office documents from OneDrive with scheduled synchronization and business account support
- [S3 Connector](https://supermemory.ai/docs/connectors/s3.md): Connect Amazon S3 or S3-compatible storage to sync files into your Supermemory knowledge base
- [Granola connector](https://supermemory.ai/docs/connectors/granola.md): Sync AI meeting notes and transcripts from Granola into your Supermemory knowledge base
- [GitHub connector](https://supermemory.ai/docs/connectors/github.md): Connect GitHub repositories to sync documentation files into your Supermemory knowledge base
- [Web Crawler connector](https://supermemory.ai/docs/connectors/web-crawler.md): Crawl and sync websites automatically with scheduled recrawling and robots.txt compliance
- [Connector troubleshooting](https://supermemory.ai/docs/connectors/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose and resolve common issues with Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, and OneDrive connectors
- [Managing Connector Selection](https://supermemory.ai/docs/connectors/managing-resources.md): Choose what a connector syncs with the hosted picker or a direct selection update
- [Search](https://supermemory.ai/docs/recall/search.md): Semantic search across your memories and documents
- [User profiles](https://supermemory.ai/docs/recall/user-profiles.md): Fetch and use automatically maintained user context
- [Memory Operations](https://supermemory.ai/docs/recall/memory-operations.md): Forget extracted memories exactly or by meaning
- [Review inferred memories](https://supermemory.ai/docs/recall/memory-review.md): List low-confidence inferred memories, then approve, decline or undo them.
- [SMFS](https://supermemory.ai/docs/smfs/overview.md): Memory your agent can grep.
- [Install SMFS](https://supermemory.ai/docs/smfs/install.md): Install, log in, mount.
- [Mount](https://supermemory.ai/docs/smfs/mount.md): Mount a Supermemory container, generate memories, and sync.

- [Supermemory local](https://supermemory.ai/docs/self-hosting/overview.md): State-of-the-art memory, running on your machine. One binary, zero config.
- [Self-hosting quickstart](https://supermemory.ai/docs/self-hosting/quickstart.md): From zero to your first memory in under two minutes.

- [Migrate Supermemory v3/v4 to v5](https://supermemory.ai/docs/migration/api-v5.md): Upgrade legacy API calls to the namespace-scoped v5 API

- [Migrate document and file updates to v5](https://supermemory.ai/docs/migration/api-v5-document-updates.md): Choose append, replacement, or metadata-only updates deliberately
- [Migrate content management to v5](https://supermemory.ai/docs/migration/api-v5-document-reads.md): Upgrade document retrieval, resource lists, and document or memory deletion
- [Migrate search to v5](https://supermemory.ai/docs/migration/api-v5-recall.md): Upgrade search modes, filters, included context, defaults, and response readers
- [Migrate profiles and buckets to v5](https://supermemory.ai/docs/migration/api-v5-profiles.md): Separate profile retrieval from search and manage namespace-owned buckets
- [Migrate memory forgetting to v5](https://supermemory.ai/docs/migration/api-v5-memory-forgetting.md): Replace legacy exact and semantic forgetting with one response contract
- [Migrate container tags to namespaces](https://supermemory.ai/docs/migration/api-v5-settings.md): Upgrade namespace discovery, settings, deletion, and moves
- [Migrate organization settings to v5](https://supermemory.ai/docs/migration/api-v5-organization.md): Reduce organization settings to shared context and namespace count
- [Migrate metadata filters to v5](https://supermemory.ai/docs/migration/api-v5-filters.md): Convert legacy Query filters into strict, type-safe v5 filter expressions
- [Verify and roll out a v5 migration](https://supermemory.ai/docs/migration/api-v5-rollout.md): Prove behavioral parity, detect intentional differences, and cut over safely

- [Vercel AI SDK](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/ai-sdk.md): Use Supermemory with Vercel AI SDK for seamless memory management
- [Eve](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/eve.md): Give your Eve agent memory across conversations with Supermemory.

- [Convex](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/convex.md): Add persistent memory to Convex apps with Supermemory
- [LangChain](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/langchain.md): Build AI agents with persistent memory using LangChain and Supermemory
- [CrewAI](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/crewai.md): Add persistent memory to CrewAI agents with Supermemory
- [Agno](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/agno.md): Add persistent memory to Agno agents with Supermemory
- [Memory Graph](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/memory-graph.md): Interactive visualization for documents, memories and connections

- [Pipecat](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/pipecat.md): Integrate Supermemory with Pipecat for conversational memory in voice AI agents

- [viaSocket](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/viasocket.md): Connect Supermemory with viaSocket to build automation flows using triggers, API tokens, and actions like Gmail.
- [Zapier](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/zapier.md): Automate memory management with Supermemory in Zapier workflows
- [Upgrading @supermemory/tools to 3.0](https://supermemory.ai/docs/migration/tools-v3-upgrade.md): Migrate from @supermemory/tools 2.x to 3.0: one namespace per config, v5 option names, conversations stored as documents.
- [Upgrading @supermemory/tools to v2.0.0](https://supermemory.ai/docs/migration/tools-v2-upgrade.md): Migrate from @supermemory/tools 1.4.x to 2.0.0: the config-object signature, customId and new defaults.
- [API reference](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/overview.md): Interactive reference for the Supermemory HTTP API: ingest, search, profiles, memories, connectors and settings.
- [API keys & auth](https://supermemory.ai/docs/authentication.md): Org API keys, namespace-scoped keys, and connector branding.
- [Ingest](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/ingest.md): Add documents, files, batches, and conversations to Supermemory.
- [Add document](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/ingest/add-document.md): Add a document with any content type (text, url, file, etc.) and metadata
- [Upload a file](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/ingest/upload-a-file.md): Upload a file to be processed
- [Batch add documents](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/ingest/batch-add-documents.md): Add multiple documents in a single request. Each document can have any content type (text, url, file, etc.) and metadata
- [Ingest or update conversation](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/ingest/ingest-or-update-conversation.md): Ingest or update a conversation
- [Get document](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/documents/get-document.md): Get a document by ID
- [Recall](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/search.md): Semantic search over memories, document chunks or both, plus user profiles.
- [Search memory entries](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/recall-search/search-memory-entries.md): Search memory entries - Low latency for conversational
- [Search documents](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/documents/search-documents.md): Search memories with advanced filtering
- [Profiles](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/profiles.md): Static and dynamic facts about an entity, scoped to a container.
- [Get user profile](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/profiles/get-user-profile.md): Get user profile with optional search results
- [Get profile buckets](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/profiles/get-profile-buckets.md): Returns the effective profile bucket definitions for a given container tag — org-level buckets merged with any container-tag-level additions.
- [Documents](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/documents.md): List, get status, update, delete, and inspect ingested documents.
- [List documents](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/documents/list-documents.md): Retrieves a paginated list of documents with their metadata and workflow status
- [Get processing documents](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/documents/get-processing-documents.md): Get documents that are currently being processed. Default `view=active` is the live in-flight queue. `view=pending` is every unfinished document with no time cutoff. `view=all` also includes failed documents, paginated.
- [Update document](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/ingest/update-document.md): Update a document with any content type (text, url, file, etc.) and metadata
- [Delete document by ID or customId](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/ingest/delete-document-by-id-or-customid.md): Delete a document by ID or customId
- [Bulk delete documents](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/ingest/bulk-delete-documents.md): Bulk delete documents by IDs or container tags
- [Get document chunks](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/documents/get-document-chunks.md): Get all chunks for a document, ordered by position
- [Get presigned file URL](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/documents/get-presigned-file-url.md): Get a fresh presigned URL for a document's file. Returns a time-limited URL (24h) that can be used to download the file.
- [Memories](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/memories.md): Create, list, update, and forget extracted memory entries (v4).
- [Create memories directly](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/content-management/create-memories-directly.md): Create memories directly, bypassing the document ingestion workflow. Generates embeddings and makes them immediately searchable.
- [List memory entries with history](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/content-management/list-memory-entries-with-history.md): List all latest memory entries from specified container tags with their update history and source documents
- [Update a memory (creates new version)](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/content-management/update-a-memory-creates-new-version.md): Update a memory by creating a new version. The original memory is preserved with isLatest=false.
- [Forget a memory](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/content-management/forget-a-memory.md): Forget (soft delete) a memory entry. The memory is marked as forgotten but not permanently deleted.
- [Forget memories matching a prompt/query](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/content-management/forget-memories-matching-a-promptquery.md): Agentic mass-forget. Given a prompt or query, a tool-calling agent searches the container's memories and soft-deletes everything matching the target. Use dryRun to preview first.
- [Container tags](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/container-tags.md): Settings, merge and delete for multi-tenant containers.
- [Get container tag settings](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/container-tags/get-container-tag-settings.md): Get settings for a container tag
- [Update container tag settings](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/container-tags/update-container-tag-settings.md): Update settings for a container tag
- [Delete container tag](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/container-tags/delete-container-tag.md): Delete a container tag and all its documents and memories. Only organization owners and admins can perform this action.
- [Merge container tags](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/container-tags/merge-container-tags.md): Merge multiple container tags into a target tag. All documents from the source tags will be updated to reference the target tag, and the source tags will be deleted after successful merge.
- [Get container tag merge status](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/container-tags/get-container-tag-merge-status.md): Get queued container tag merge status
- [Connections](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/connections.md): Create, configure, sync and manage external connectors.
- [Create connection](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/connections/create-connection.md): Initialize connection and get authorization URL
- [List connections](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/connections/list-connections.md): List all connections
- [Get connection (by id)](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/connections/get-connection-by-id.md): Get connection details with id
- [Configure connection](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/connections/configure-connection.md): Configure resources for a connection (supported providers: GitHub for now)
- [Fetch resources](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/connections/fetch-resources.md): Fetch resources for a connection (supported providers: GitHub for now)
- [Sync connection](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/connections/sync-connection.md): Initiate a manual sync of connections
- [List documents](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/connections/list-documents.md): List documents indexed for a provider and container tags
- [Get connection (by provider)](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/connections/get-connection-by-provider.md): Get connection details with provider and container tags
- [Delete connection by ID](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/connections/delete-connection-by-id.md): Delete a specific connection by ID
- [Delete connection](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/connections/delete-connection.md): Delete connection for a specific provider and container tags
- [Settings](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/settings.md): Organization settings, profile buckets, and data reset.
- [Get settings](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/settings/get-settings.md): Get settings for an organization
- [Update settings](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/settings/update-settings.md): Update settings for an organization
- [Suggest profile buckets](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/settings/suggest-profile-buckets.md): Suggest profile bucket definitions based on the organization context prompt. Returns 3–6 bucket suggestions tailored to the use-case described in the prompt.
- [Reset organization data](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/settings/reset-organization-data.md): Reset organization content: removes documents, memories, spaces (except default project), connections, and org settings. Preserves the org, members, and billing.
- [Send feedback](https://supermemory.ai/docs/api-reference/feedback/send-feedback.md): Report a bug, request a feature or flag a docs problem to the Supermemory team. Built for AI agents: send structured JSON and an engineer picks it up.
- [API reference](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/overview.md): Documents, search, profiles, lists, memories, namespaces, and organization settings in the latest Supermemory API
- [API keys & auth](https://supermemory.ai/docs/authentication.md): Org API keys, namespace-scoped keys, and connector branding.
- [Ingest](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/ingest.md): Turn source content into searchable memory and keep it current
- [Add document](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/ingest/add-document.md): Turn text or a supported URL into searchable, evolving memory. Supply a new ID to create a document, or reuse an existing ID to append new information while preserving its history.
- [Batch add documents](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/ingest/batch-add-documents.md): Build a knowledge base efficiently by ingesting up to 600 text or URL documents at once. Existing caller-defined IDs append new information using the same semantics as single-document ingestion.
- [Upload file](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/ingest/upload-file.md): Transform an uploaded file into searchable knowledge and learned memory. The response returns as soon as ingestion is safely queued while extraction and memory formation continue asynchronously.
- [Update document](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/ingest/update-document.md): Refresh an existing document without changing its stable ID. Supplied content replaces the canonical content and is reprocessed; omitted fields remain unchanged.
- [Replace document with file](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/ingest/replace-document-with-file.md): Replace an existing document with a new file while keeping its stable document ID. Content and caller metadata are overwritten, then the document is reprocessed asynchronously.
- [Partially update document file](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/ingest/partially-update-document-file.md): Refresh only the file-backed fields you provide. Supplying a file replaces the canonical content; omitted metadata and processing context remain unchanged.
- [Content management](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/content-management.md): Retrieve, list, and remove documents, chunks, and memories
- [Get document](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/content-management/get-document.md): Retrieve a document's canonical content, metadata, and processing state by document ID or caller-defined ID. Optionally include its source chunks, derived memories, or both in the same response.
- [List resources](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/content-management/list-resources.md): Browse documents, source chunks, or learned memories through one predictable paginated contract. Choose the collection in the path; the other collection arrays remain empty for a stable response shape.
- [Delete documents](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/content-management/delete-documents.md): Permanently remove documents and their derived knowledge by document ID or caller-defined ID. Each requested ID is handled independently so successful deletions are preserved when another ID fails.
- [Forget memories by ID](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/content-management/forget-memories-by-id.md): Remove exact memories from normal recall while preserving their audit history. Each ID is handled independently and any missing or ineligible memory is reported without rolling back successful changes.
- [Forget memories semantically](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/content-management/forget-memories-semantically.md): Describe what should be forgotten in natural language, then preview or apply the matching set. Use dry-run results with the exact-ID endpoint when you need a reviewable, drift-free workflow.
- [Search](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/search.md): Recall the most relevant memories and source context
- [Search memories](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/recall-search/search-memories.md): Recall the most relevant learned context and source passages from a namespace. Hybrid search combines memories with document chunks by default, with optional query rewriting, reranking, and supporting context attachments.
- [Profiles](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/profiles.md): Turn accumulated memory into a ready-to-use understanding of a user
- [Get profile](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/profiles/get-profile.md): Read a continuously maintained understanding of the subject represented by this namespace. Stable facts, evolving context, and selected custom buckets are returned together without requiring a search query.
- [Get profile buckets](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/profiles/get-profile-buckets.md): Inspect the profile taxonomy active in this namespace. The response combines organization-wide buckets with namespace-owned additions as a concise name-to-description map.
- [Add or update profile buckets](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/profiles/add-or-update-profile-buckets.md): Teach Supermemory new ways to organize this namespace's profile, or refine how existing namespace-owned buckets are classified. Omitted buckets remain unchanged and organization-wide buckets stay protected.
- [Delete profile buckets](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/profiles/delete-profile-buckets.md): Remove profile categories created specifically for this namespace. Unknown names are safely ignored, while organization-wide buckets remain protected.
- [Namespaces](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/namespaces.md): Keep memory isolated, understandable, and easy to reorganize
- [List namespaces](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/namespaces/list-namespaces.md): Discover every namespace available to the caller, including its purpose, document volume, memory count, and lifecycle timestamps.
- [Get namespace settings](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/namespaces/get-namespace-settings.md): Read the supporting context that helps Supermemory understand content and form better memories inside this namespace.
- [Update namespace settings](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/namespaces/update-namespace-settings.md): Shape how Supermemory understands an existing namespace by updating the background context used during ingestion and memory formation.
- [Delete namespace](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/namespaces/delete-namespace.md): Retire a namespace by permanently deleting its content, or preserve that knowledge by moving everything into another namespace first. Moves are queued and complete asynchronously.
- [Connectors](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/connectors.md): Sync Notion, Google Drive, Gmail, GitHub, websites, S3 buckets, and Granola into a namespace
- [Create connector](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/connectors/create-connector.md): Connect an external source to this namespace. OAuth providers return an authorization url to send the user to; providers that authenticate with config start syncing right away.
- [List connectors](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/connectors/list-connectors.md): List the connectors that sync into this namespace.
- [Get connector](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/connectors/get-connector.md): Read one connector. Add include=syncs to include its recent sync runs and the items that failed. include=picker needs an admin with write access, since the link changes what syncs.
- [Update connector](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/connectors/update-connector.md): Change what a connector syncs. A new selection replaces the old one and starts a sync.
- [Sync connector](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/connectors/sync-connector.md): Start a sync now. Returns 409 while a sync for this connector is already running.
- [Delete connector](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/connectors/delete-connector.md): Disconnect a connector and stop its webhooks. Its imported documents are deleted too unless deleteDocuments is false.
- [List all connectors](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/connectors/list-all-connectors.md): List connectors across every namespace this key can read. Use it for admin views that span users or projects.
- [Organization](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/organization.md): Give every namespace a shared understanding of your organization
- [Get organization settings](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/organization/get-organization-settings.md): Read the shared background that guides memory formation across the organization, together with the number of active namespaces.
- [Update organization settings](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/organization/update-organization-settings.md): Give Supermemory organization-wide background that improves how content is interpreted across every namespace. Send null to remove the existing context.
- [Send feedback](https://supermemory.ai/docs/v5/api-reference/feedback/send-feedback.md): Report a bug, request a feature or flag a docs problem to the Supermemory team. Built for AI agents: send structured JSON and an engineer picks it up.
- [Overview](https://supermemory.ai/docs/supermemory-mcp/mcp.md): Give every MCP-compatible assistant shared memory, team spaces, and interactive workflows
- [Setup and usage](https://supermemory.ai/docs/supermemory-mcp/setup.md): Connect Supermemory to an MCP client with OAuth and choose how requests use spaces
- [ChatGPT Web](https://supermemory.ai/docs/supermemory-mcp/chatgpt-web.md): Connect Supermemory MCP to ChatGPT Web and make Supermemory the default for memory, recall, and saved context
- [Claude Desktop](https://supermemory.ai/docs/supermemory-mcp/claude-desktop.md): Connect Supermemory MCP in Claude via Settings → Connectors
- [OpenClaw](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/openclaw.md): Supermemory plugin for OpenClaw. Works across Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, Slack and more.
- [Hermes](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/hermes.md): Supermemory plugin for Hermes. Semantic memory, profiles and search across Telegram, Discord, Slack, the CLI and more.
- [Claude Code](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/claude-code.md): Supermemory plugin for Claude Code. Keeps memory across coding sessions.
- [Muse Code](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/muse-code.md): Persistent memory for Meta Muse Code with the muse-supermemory plugin.
- [Codex](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/codex.md): Persistent memory for the OpenAI Codex CLI with the codex-supermemory plugin.
- [OpenCode](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/opencode.md): Supermemory plugin for OpenCode. Keeps memory across coding sessions.
- [Cursor](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/cursor.md): cursor-supermemory: persistent memory across your Cursor chats
- [Grok Bot](https://supermemory.ai/docs/integrations/grok-bot.md): Supermemory for Grok Bot: persistent memory for your Grok Bots
